title: Q3LOCK Kozitsky survey primary scalar/radial boundary
question: Does the accessible primary Kozitsky overview contain a finite-temperature theorem that directly covers the positive-lambda non-radial eight-component Q3LOCK model, or does it only summarize scalar/radial quantum-crystal results?
method: Read the primary arXiv PDF 1806.08264v1 at equations (1.1)-(1.5), the path-measure construction (1.11)-(1.15), and Theorem 2.1.
Read the primary overview 1204.6279v1 around its vector/scalar split and condition (90), and compare the directly checked scalar asymmetric Theorem 1.4 of math-ph/0611017v1.
Compare site dimension, onsite polynomial, interaction, order parameter, source/cusp mechanism and conclusion with the Q3LOCK manuscript; reject scalar projection and novelty/priority inference.
finding: The exact checked Kozitsky overview theorem uses one scalar displacement per site with a scalar double-well quartic and scalar nearest-neighbour coupling. It provides Euclidean Gibbs/DLR context and a scalar/radial low-temperature phase condition, but it does not directly cover the positive-lambda non-radial R^8 Q3LOCK polynomial, the collective zero-source cusp, or the selected parity-related DLR pair. The broader anisotropic theorem question remains open.
decision_reason: This is a primary-source applicability boundary that narrows a direct-import shortcut without claiming novelty or exhausting the literature. It strengthens the specialist handoff while retaining the signed literature gate and the deferred-PDF rule.
boundary: T0 comparison-only literature audit; no direct phase-theorem import, theorem promotion, novelty or priority claim, claim-tier change, Sector A-F status change, submission, or PDF.
next_action: Add this exact scalar/radial boundary to the specialist literature handoff, obtain Schneider--Beck--Stoll full-text assessment and a signed search disposition for any broader anisotropic continuous-oscillator theorem before content freeze.
non_claims: The scalar/radial survey theorem is not imported as a Q3LOCK vector theorem.
The bounded source check does not establish absence, novelty or priority.
No Q3LOCK pressure, FKG, infrared, cusp, DLR multiplicity or phase theorem is certified by this comparison.
